dialogue.speaker: Maxwell
dialogue.text: You keep showing up. You keep trying to talk to me. Why?

dialogue.speaker: Maxwell
dialogue.text: Do you think I could ever be like you?

dialogue.speaker: Maxwell
dialogue.text: You do not know what it is like to wake up every day and feel like you are already failing.

dialogue.speaker: Maxwell
dialogue.text: I try. I really do. But every time I look at you, I see everything I am not.

dialogue.speaker: Narrator
dialogue.text: Maxwell's voice cracks. He turns away, shoulders tense.

dialogue.speaker: Narrator
dialogue.text: He does not wait for you to speak. He storms out of the room.
